_comment_schema: Scoop manifest schema v1. Placeholders must be updated per release.
description: pCloud console client (Rust rewrite) - CLI and daemon for pCloud.
pre_install: Write-Host 'pcloud-rs requires WinFSP for the mounted-drive feature.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host 'Scoop will install the winfsp dependency, but WinFSP ships a kernel-mode driver' -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host 'that may require a reboot or an elevated installer prompt before pcloudd can mount.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host 'If mount fails after install, reboot and retry, or install WinFSP from https://winfsp.dev/ manually.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
